user.title: Apparent temperature
user.description: Combine local sensors with a weather entity to compute a perceived temperature. Everything is optional: each quantity falls back to the weather entity on its own.

data_description.weather_entity: Used for any quantity no sensor group can provide.
data_description.formula: How the perceived temperature is derived from temperature, humidity and wind.

data_description.ignore_non_numeric: When off, a single unusable sensor makes the whole group fall back to the weather entity.
